user.title: Connect to Warmup
user.description: Enter the username and password you use to sign in to the My Warmup app or website.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Warmup
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} is no longer valid. Enter the current password to continue.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Warmup servers.

abort.already_configured: This Warmup account is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Warmup servers.

yaml_deprecated.title: Warmup YAML configuration is deprecated
yaml_deprecated.description: Configuring Warmup ({username}) via `climate:` in `configuration.yaml` is deprecated and has been automatically imported as a config entry. Remove the `platform: warmup` entry for {username} from your `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to connect to the Warmup servers: {error}

unsupported_preset_mode.message: Warmup thermostats don't support the preset mode "{preset_mode}".

unsupported_hvac_mode.message: Warmup thermostats don't support the HVAC mode "{hvac_mode}".

entry_not_loaded.message: The Warmup integration for this location isn't loaded.

holiday_end_before_start.message: The holiday must end after it starts.

override_duration_invalid.message: An override must last between 1 minute and 24 hours; this one would last {minutes} minutes.

set_override.name: Set override
set_override.description: Sets a temporary temperature for a room until a time of day or for a duration (1 hour if neither is given), after which the room returns to its schedule.

until.name: Until
until.description: Time of day the override ends. Use either this or duration.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the override lasts, up to 24 hours. Use either this or until.

set_holiday.name: Set holiday
set_holiday.description: Puts every room at a Warmup location in holiday mode between two times.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Temperature every room holds during the holiday.

cancel_holiday.name: Cancel holiday
cancel_holiday.description: Cancels holiday mode at a Warmup location. Rooms in frost protection also return to their schedule.

data_description.boost_duration: How long the Boost preset overrides a room's temperature, in minutes (1 to 1440).
